PLAN "12-Week Vegan Hypertrophy + Protein Plan"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "muscle gain and plant-based protein compliance"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation Hypertrophy" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper 1 Push Emphasis":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Lower 1 Squat Emphasis":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper 2 Pull Emphasis":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x4..8 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower 2 Hinge Emphasis":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          romanian_deadlift 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds

        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Saturday training 30m "Optional Cardio + Mobility":

    - "Sample day (~150g protein): breakfast oatmeal with soy_isolate (35g protein); lunch tofu bowl with quinoa and black_beans (40g); snack pea_protein smoothie (30g); dinner tempeh stir-fry with edamame (35g); snack soy_yogurt alternative or hummus with pita (10g)."
    - "Distribute protein 25..40g per meal, 4..6 feedings/day. Use fortified plant milks for calcium and B12; consider creatine 3..5g/day and algae-based DHA/EPA."
    - "Hydration: 2..3L/day; pre-workout carb 20..40g; post-workout 30g protein from soy or pea plus carbs."
